sampling: All sequential, taskset -c 2-6. Three pairs B/C, C/B, B/C. 30 flat samples for preflight and native_validation, 20 for native_lifetime; 300ms warmup, 2s measurement target.

Dense:16MiB buffered/direct QD8/64KiB native versus4-worker threaded64KiB. Both executors changed in R0.5; threaded is a comparator, not an unchanged control.
timing: Planning timer includes validation/metadata/extents/plan construction. Copy timer includes preflight/setup/execution/cleanup/flush; reset/flush and full verification outside. All copies verify output; dense copies verify FD counts.
limits: Shared development laptop, powersave, uncontrolled background work; warm buffered files and default Btrfs compression; no cold-device or sustained-throughput claim.
followup: Direct QD8/64KiB only: three pairs in C/B, B/C, C/B order, 30 flat samples, 500ms warmup, 3s target, same2-6 affinity. Investigates pair-to-pair storage drift.
final_refinement: Reject all access modes except named O_RDONLY/O_WRONLY/O_RDWR; add ioctl-only mode regression. Full final measurements repeated with unchanged baseline binaries and harness.
